priorityFindings.title: Content Security Policy is enforced globally with request-scoped nonces
evidence: product/src/proxy.ts is registered by Next.js 16 as Proxy (Middleware) and emits CSP on protected document responses
a fresh cryptographic nonce is propagated to Next.js request headers and to the response CSP for each document request
production script-src excludes unsafe-inline and unsafe-eval and uses self + nonce + strict-dynamic
object-src 'none', base-uri 'none', frame-ancestors 'none', form-action 'self' and bounded resource origins are explicit

connect-src permits only the configured Supabase project origin, its WebSocket origin and the exact derived <project>.storage.supabase.co TUS origin required by large resumable Knowledge uploads; no wildcard is used
Human + Visual Acceptance verifies the CSP response header, framework nonce use, absence of CSP violations and nonce rotation on desktop/mobile
K1 verifies the >6 MiB resumable PDF journey through Supabase Storage under the production CSP
P6 confirms the dynamic request-scoped policy remains inside performance budgets
priorityFindings.closure: Add and test a production-compatible CSP meeting ASVS 5.0 V3.4.3, then attach repository and runtime header receipts.

priorityFindings.title: Uploaded file content is validated against declared type before KB admission
evidence: all three upload ingress paths are governed: server action, same-origin API and resumable Storage flow
PDF and DOCX are validated with real parsers; PNG/JPEG/WebP with binary signatures; text with strict UTF-8 and NUL/binary rejection
extension/MIME/content mismatches and disguised files are covered by negative tests
resumable blobs are re-read server-side before KB admission; inconsistent blobs are rejected and removed
the client is not a security authority
priorityFindings.closure: Validate accepted file content/signature against the allowed type before persistence/processing and add negative tests.

priorityFindings.title: MFA TOTP and AAL2 are required for protected application scope
evidence: password and recovery/magic-link establish only the first-factor session and protected application surfaces require MFA
Supabase TOTP enrollment/challenge/verify is implemented without a test bypass
AAL1 is denied on protected pages, application APIs, RLS-governed database access, Storage and guarded RPC paths
0051_mfa_aal2_enforcement.sql applies restrictive AAL2 policies and a future-table ratchet
recovery password mutation is denied before AAL2 and permitted only after a valid MFA challenge
real human recovery via email completed AAL1 -> MFA -> AAL2 -> new password save
subsequent sign-in using the new password required MFA again and reached the operational Oggi surface
isolated provider-native Supabase and Render runtime evidence is recorded in ops/mfa-v6-3-3-closure-receipt.json
priorityFindings.closure: Implement and require an L2-compatible factor combination for the protected application scope, with recovery/session tests, provider-runtime evidence and human validation of recovery plus subsequent sign-in.
